answer.reason: The verses tell of Nineveh's repentance at Jonah's preaching and of the prophesied desolation, which go beyond the summary.

clauses.english: repented at Jonah's preaching, believing God and fasting in sackcloth
clauses.quote: So the people of Nineveh believed God, and proclaimed a fast, and put on sackcloth

clauses.english: was foretold to be made a desolation, dry like a wilderness
clauses.quote: will make Nineveh a desolation, and dry like a wilderness

doubts: Nineveh's founding by Asshur (GEN 10:11) was left out as the summary already places the city; the Nahum verses are oracles of doom and were not given a separate clause, to avoid duplicating the Zephaniah prophecy.
